{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "cyb3ralbert",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "reported stalled outbound peer not being evicted; asked questions about latency and testing"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:6161235415",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A stalled peer that stops responding to getheaders remains connected indefinitely, holding the outbound slot.",
      "quote": "With a single outbound peer, a peer that sends one headers message and then stops responding to `getheaders` remains connected for 24 hours under mocktime, whereas master disconnects it after 24 minutes.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author confirmed and pushed bf56f4fb83 renewing the timeout only if presync work increased",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6163775056"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6163775056",
      "status_by_quote": "Pushed bf56f4fb83. The presync work is now recorded when the timeout is set, and when it expires the timeout is only renewed if that work has increased since."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6161235415",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Whether the Tor/I2P latency scenario is expected to apply when there is only a single outbound peer.",
      "quote": "Is the Tor/I2P latency scenario expected to apply when this is the only outbound peer?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained that logic is independent of peer count",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6163775056"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6163775056",
      "status_by_quote": "Single outbound peer: nothing in the logic depends on how many outbound peers there are, so a slow Tor/I2P link can hit it with one peer as well"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6161235415",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "Whether the eviction was observed on a real node or inferred from expected round-trip times.",
      "quote": "Was the eviction observed on a real node, or inferred from expected round-trip times?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed it was inferred from mainnet round trips and reproduced in mocktime tests",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6163775056"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6163775056",
      "status_by_quote": "Real node: no, the eviction was not observed on a real node. It is inferred from the ~480 presync round trips on mainnet against the ~22 minute window"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "cyb3ralbert to review the fix in bf56f4fb83",
      "id": "c:6163775056"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial record. cyb3ralbert found that stalled peers were never evicted and asked about the scenario; author answered and pushed a fix with an added test."
}
